description.value:
Retributive energy flows through your weapon, ready to rebound. For the duration, the first time on your turn that you hit with a melee Strike, that Strike deals 1d6 extra force damage. In addition, when a creature within melee reach hits you with a melee Strike, that creature must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC. Any resulting movement is instantaneous and does not trigger reactions. The creature may attempt a new Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns to end the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]{Prone} condition early.

Success The striking creature is unaffected.

Failure The striking creature is launched 5 feet away from you and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The striking creature is launched 10 feet away from you and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]{Prone}.

Heightened (+1) The extra force damage on your Strikes increases by 1d4 and the launch distance on failure increases by 5 feet.
